title: I wasn't worried about climate change. Now I am.
summary: Sabine Hossenfelder explains climate sensitivity and why recent observations suggest climate models may have underestimated warming. She says this changed her view on how worried to be.
why: HN commenters link it as the direct source on climate sensitivity and on the claim that past models ran too cold.
